WITH per_item AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    AVG(1.0 * product_price / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_of_item_average_ratios,
  AVG(1.0 * line_item_count) AS average_invoice_line_item_count
FROM per_item;

assumptions.assumption: A zero derived_total_cost makes the ratio undefined and is skipped, as are ratios with either value missing; each row in Invoice_Line_Items counts as one line item.
